mapper.sql: FROM ticket ticket_item INNER JOIN ticket_category category ON category.id = ticket_item.category_id INNER JOIN sys_user requester ON requester.id = ticket_item.requester_id INNER JOIN sys_department requester_department ON requester_department.id = ticket_item.requester_department_id LEFT JOIN sys_user assignee ON assignee.id = ticket_item.assignee_id

where.if: AND (ticket_item.ticket_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{criteria.keyword}, '%') OR ticket_item.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{criteria.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.sql: ticket_item.id, ticket_item.ticket_no, ticket_item.title, ticket_item.description, ticket_item.status, ticket_item.category_id, category.name AS category_name, ticket_item.requester_id, requester.name AS requester_name, requester_department.name AS requester_department_name, ticket_item.assignee_id, assignee.name AS assignee_name, ticket_item.version, ticket_item.resolved_time, ticket_item.closed_time, ticket_item.create_time, ticket_item.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT record_item.id, record_item.action, record_item.from_status AS fromStatus, record_item.to_status AS toStatus, record_item.content, record_item.operator_id AS operatorId, operator.name AS operatorName, record_item.target_user_id AS targetUserId, target_user.name AS targetUserName, record_item.create_time AS createTime FROM ticket_record record_item INNER JOIN sys_user operator ON operator.id = record_item.operator_id LEFT JOIN sys_user target_user ON target_user.id = record_item.target_user_id WHERE record_item.ticket_id = #{ticketId} ORDER BY record_item.create_time ASC, record_item.id ASC
